WITH first_payment_per_customer AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        MIN(payment_date) as first_payment_date
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
first_payment_with_tiebreaker AS (
    SELECT 
        fpc.customer_id,
        fpc.first_payment_date,
        p.payment_id,
        p.rental_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fpc.customer_id ORDER BY p.payment_date, p.payment_id) as rn
    FROM payment p
    JOIN first_payment_per_customer fpc ON p.customer_id = fpc.customer_id AND p.payment_date = fpc.first_payment_date
),
first_payment_record AS (
    SELECT customer_id, payment_id, rental_id
    FROM first_payment_with_tiebreaker

),
first_rental AS (
    SELECT

        p.rental_id
    FROM first_payment_record fp

),
first_movie_details AS (
    SELECT 
        fr.customer_id,
        f.rating
    FROM first_rental fr
    JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = fr.rental_id
    JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
    JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
),
customer_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        COUNT(*) as total_rentals,
        SUM(amount) as total_amount
    FROM payment

)

    ROUND(AVG(cs.total_amount), 2) as avg_total_amount,
    ROUND(AVG(cs.total_rentals - 1), 2) as avg_subsequent_rentals
FROM first_movie_details fmd
JOIN customer_stats cs ON cs.cu

WITH first_payment AS (
    SELECT customer_id, payment_id, rental_id
    FROM (
        SELECT customer_id, payment_id, rental_id,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_date) as rn

    SELECT fp.customer_id, fp.rental_id
    FROM first_payment fp
),
first_film AS (
    SELECT fr.customer_id, fr.rental_id, r.inventory_id, i.film_id
    FROM first_rental fr
    JOIN rental r ON fr.rental_id = r.rental_id
    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
),
first_rating AS (
    SELECT ff.customer_id, ff.film_id, f.rating
    FROM first_film ff
    JOIN film f ON ff.film_id = f.film_id
),
customer_amount AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, SUM(p.amount) as total_amount
    FROM customer c
    JOIN payment p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
),
customer_rentals AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT r.rental_id) as total_rentals
    FROM customer c
    LEFT JOIN rental r ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    fr.rating,
    AVG(ca.total_amount) as avg_total_amount,
    AVG(cr.total_rentals - 1) as avg_subsequent_rentals
FROM first_rating fr
JOIN customer_amount ca ON fr.customer_id = ca.customer_id
JOIN customer_rentals cr ON fr.customer_id = cr.customer_id
GROUP BY fr.rating
ORDER BY fr.rating

SELECT 
    fm.rating,
    AVG(p.total_amount) as avg_total_amount,
    AVG(CAST(r.total_rentals AS DOUBLE) - 1) as avg_subsequent_rentals
FROM (
    SELECT 
        p.customer_id,
        SUM(p.amount) as total_amount
    FROM payment p
    GROUP BY p.customer_id
) p
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT 
        r.customer_id,
        COUNT(*) as total_rentals
    FROM rental r
    GROUP BY r.customer_id
) r ON p.customer_id = r.customer_id
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT 
        p.customer_id,
        p.payment_id,
        r.inventory_id,
        i.film_id,
        f.rating
    FROM payment p
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT customer_id, MIN(payment_date) as first_payment_date
        FROM payment
        GROUP BY customer_id
    ) fp ON p.customer_id = fp.customer_id AND p.payment_date = fp.first_payment_date
    INNER JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
    INNER JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    INNER JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
) fm ON p.customer_id = fm.customer_id
GROUP BY fm.rating
ORDER BY fm.rating
